['Select molecule_chembl_id as chembl_id, canonical_smiles, standard_type, standard_value, standard_units', 'From activities', 'Join assays on activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id', 'Join target_dictionary on assays.tid = target_dictionary.tid', 'Join compound_structures on activities.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', "Where target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL206'", "Filter standard_type = 'IC50'", 'Filter standard_value IS NOT NULL', "Filter standard_relation = '='", 'Order by standard_value', 'Limit 500']
